The whys[] agree with the packet on those two rows. The mirror wanted Trundle through first item and Skill at two-plus, which is what is on disk; that is the one dissenting source and it argued from its own rating tokens rather than from data, so I followed the packet and the prose. Flagged for the user.
audit.corrected: Rows 5 and 6 to Tryndamere, as matched full/content pairs with ratings and reasons. Rows 0-4 left as Trundle, which all three sources agree on.

audit.whatIsWrong: No numbers, and the level-6 comparison is never made.
audit.why: Subjugate is 120/100/80 and Undying Rage is 120/100/80 — the two ultimates are on identical cooldowns at every rank, so they trade one-for-one and the 6 window resets together. Subjugate's steal is applied immediately and then doubled over the next 4 seconds, so surviving the four seconds is the counterplay. Chomp 3.5s, Frozen Domain 18/17/16/15/14, Pillar of Ice 21/19.5/18/16.5/15.
audit.corrected: The matched ultimate cooldowns and the 4-second ramp written into spikes[1], breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Subjugate is named as the cooldown to track and bait. On a 3.5s Chomp and a 21s Pillar of Ice, that is the wrong target. Frozen Domain is described only as a heal, and Chomp's auto-reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: Chomp is a 3.5s auto-attack reset at 300 range that saps your Attack Damage onto him — it cannot be baited, it is simply always up, and its tell is the auto wind-up, not a cast. Riot's Frozen Domain text grants 'increased healing from all sources while on it', so it multiplies King's Tribute and every other heal — the counterplay is fighting him off the zone, and it is what makes Grievous Wounds timing matter. Pillar of Ice at 21s is the one long cooldown in his kit and the only real bait, and it is impassable terrain that cuts your retreat.
audit.corrected: The cooldown focus moved to Pillar of Ice, Frozen Domain restated as a healing amplifier to fight off, and Chomp's reset named.

notes: The packet suspectName 'Use Undying Rage' is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name with a verb in front. The whole page was built around baiting Subjugate; the actually-baitable cooldown is Pillar of Ice at 21s, since Chomp is 3.5s and Frozen Domain 18s. Frozen Domain increases healing from ALL sources, which is the real reason Grievous Wounds and off-domain fighting matter. The mirror kit-file gap it flagged still stands: Spinning Slash carries no dash flag in champ-data/_kits/tryndamere.json even though it is a dash, so Pillar of Ice never gets raised against it — I did not assert that the pillar stops the spin, only that it cuts the retreat.
